rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a hostile attitude or feeling towards someone.

example.english: They are full of hostility toward the new neighbors and are always scowling.
example.traditional: 佢對新搬嚟嘅鄰居充滿敵意，成日黑口黑面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 san1 bun1 lai4 ge3 leon4 geoi1 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3 seng4 jat6 hak1 hau2 hak1 min6
